description:
Create a report owned by the caller, private until shared.

Share it with myriade_set_report_access(visibility="everyone"): an audit
zone or domain document joins the map only once organisation-wide.

content.description: Markdown content; may cite <QUERY:id> and <CHART:id> tags. An audit zone or domain opens with its ```zone or ```domain block.
content.title: Content

database_id.description: UUID of the database the report is written from. Omit for an organisation-level report (audit zones and domains are).
database_id.title: Database Id

name: myriade_create_report
